identity.one_liner: DevFest workshop: build a local RAG in pure Node.js with no database
identity.review: Portuguese-language workshop material (DevFest Porto Alegre) teaching attendees to build a minimal HTTP server in Node.js that performs semantic retrieval over an FAQ, with v2 delivering the retrieved document to an LLM that answers as a salesperson persona. Uses pure Node without database, paid API, or framework: embedding runs locally on CPU via transformers.js (Xenova/multilingual-e5-small, 4-bit quantized). README is primarily prerequisite setup (Node.js 18+, Ollama pre-install, ~3.5 GB downloads) plus v1 running instructions, test questions, troubleshooting, and exercises.
highlights: ~100-line HTTP server, no database, no framework, embeddings on local CPU
v1 semantic retrieval / v2 generation via local Ollama (qwen2.5:3b)
Embedding model pre-download script with curl resumable download
Exercises covering indexing, ranking, normalization, and threshold rejection
use_cases: Workshop hands-on learning to build a minimal RAG from scratch
Understanding semantic retrieval and embedding vectors with local resources
Creating a local CPU-based FAQ search service without any paid API
